topics.name: Offline Experiences & Digital Detox
details: **What is happening:** A rising counter-trend, driven by digital fatigue, sees consumers and entrepreneurs actively seeking intentional offline experiences and digital detoxes to reclaim their attention, sanity, and real-world connections.

**Why it matters:** This trend perfectly complements FieldWork's 'Live Offline' philosophy, emphasizing the importance of disconnecting from screens to spend more time outside and with loved ones, fostering overall well-being.

details: **What is happening:** Founders are moving beyond a strict work-life separation towards integration, focusing on managing energy, setting clear boundaries, and building businesses that support long-term well-being and meaningful work.
